permission.title: Permission request
permission.subtitle: Review what this tool call is about to do, then decide whether to allow or deny it and how long that decision should stick.
permission.allow_scope_session: Allow matching requests for this session
permission.allow_scope_persistent_pattern: Always allow calls matching this pattern
permission.deny_scope_session: Deny matching requests for this session
permission.deny_scope_persistent_pattern: Always deny calls matching this pattern
permission.scope_description_one_shot: Only affects the current prompt and does not save a rule.
permission.scope_description_session: Reuses this decision for the current chat session only.
permission.scope_description_persistent_exact: Saves a long-lived rule for the same tool and the same arguments.
permission.scope_description_persistent_pattern: Saves a long-lived rule that matches the pattern you provide.
permission.pattern_help: Pattern rules are only saved when you choose a pattern-based scope.
permission.pattern_required: Enter a pattern before saving a pattern-based rule.
permission.reason_placeholder: For example: this tool is trusted for repeated use in this session
permission.reason_help: This note is attached to the current permission decision, and it is saved with the rule when you choose a persistent scope.
permission.expired_help: This request is no longer active. The agent run has already moved on from this prompt.
permission.toast_timed_out: This permission request timed out and the run was cancelled.
